scope: Reuse version-1 privacy block, frame index references and delivery helper; no classifier, automatic clearance or scenario harness.
behavior: Privacy inspection records actual author/relay, sheets/native samples and coverage; findings use final-output locations and supporting references. Historical records remain valid without upgraded review claims.
Known findings make handoffs diagnostic, even with unknown timing. Missing sampled review remains prominently unreviewed and does not require owner viewing to send a useful package.

Sample review with no findings can remain ready_for_review with explicit sampling and no-clearance limits. The helper copies no media; guidance retains real flagged material locally and restricts sharing to authorized content.
Edit-only output is reviewed in its own encode clock; no fictitious capture or environment-check claim.
